title: [Bug] [Combov2] [Latest dev] Preferences tab craches on Android 12
body:
Unfortunatly the preferences tab crashes on Android 12 (Samsung Galaxy Flip 4) and I can't pair a combo. Other preference screens on other tabs works fine. And there is no problem on my Jelly 2 with Android 11 with the same build. This problem also exists with old builds, which I also tried today: Android 11 -> no problem, Android 12 -> crash.
